reason: The README clearly presents this plugin as a DeepSeek Harness companion for conversation sessions, where users configure personas and voices and get spoken responses with optional timed greetings and chat commands, making its primary purpose a media-oriented companion/voice utility for chat interactions rather than coding, search, or project-analysis tooling.

summaries.zh: 这是一个用于 DeepSeek Harness 的对话伴随插件，支持按会话自定义人设与声音，并在回复时自动播报或通过 /speak、/cheer 命令即时朗读。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness chat companion plugin that lets each session define persona and voice, then automatically reads replies or speaks instantly via /speak and /cheer commands.

capabilities: Plays generated speech audio in the browser for assistant replies
Supports per-session persona/voice configuration for chat behavior
Provides scheduled per-session greeting prompts and explicit /speak or /cheer commands for speech actions

reasons.code: README describes configurable per-session companion settings (name/personality/voice) and automatic voice playback of each reply, showing a user-facing chat-plus-audio experience.
Architecture section shows browser fetching WAV and using <audio> playback, with plugin-side proxying to a local TTS service endpoint.
Feature list and command table define /speak and /cheer behavior to trigger spoken output and in-session encouragement content.
